description:
Follow-up to JMAP-x2gd.79 (which converted 8 public chat-server constructors to const fn). The bead noted 'Likely a workspace-sweep, not chat-server-local.' This bead tracks the broader sweep.

clippy::nursery::missing_const_for_fn fires on approximately 100+ sites across the workspace, distributed roughly:

- jmap-types: 6 sites (id.rs, patch.rs, query.rs, resultref.rs)
- jmap-server: 6 sites (backend.rs, handlers.rs)
- jmap-cid-types: 6 sites (digest.rs)
- jmap-jscalendar-types: 1 site
- jmap-mail-types: 5 sites (mailbox.rs, query.rs)
- jmap-contacts-types: 2 sites (card.rs, collision.rs)
- jmap-tasks-types: 2 sites (filter.rs, task_list.rs)
- jmap-calendars-types: 1 site (event.rs)
- jmap-filenode-types: 2 sites (filenode.rs)
- jmap-metadata-types: 3 sites (metadata.rs)
- jmap-chat-types: 4 sites (capability.rs, message.rs, space_set.rs)
- jmap-contacts-server: 10 sites in memory.rs
- jmap-chat-server: ~12 internal helpers (permissions.rs, space.rs, message.rs, position.rs, memory.rs)
- jmap-tasks-server: 10 sites in memory.rs
- jmap-metadata-server: 4 sites in memory.rs

JMAP-x2gd.79 explicitly scoped down to the 8 public chat-server constructors named in the bead (OpResult / ChatLimits / SlowModeError). The canonical-template propagation rule for the extension-server family was honored vacuously — jmap-mail-server's analogous public types (MdnSendResult, MdnParseResult) take HashMap/Vec arguments and CANNOT be const because the with_* setters assign over fields whose Drop impl is not const-evaluable. No mail-server changes needed.

Several categories of remaining sites:

1. **Foundation-crate public surface** (jmap-types, jmap-server, jmap-cid-types) — high-leverage; these are imported by every other crate. Should be tackled first.

2. **Type-crate constructors** (jmap-mail-types, jmap-chat-types, etc.) — public surface, moderate-leverage; affects consumers in *-client and *-server.

3. **Internal helpers** (memory.rs sites, chat-server permissions/space/message/position) — low-leverage; private fns visible only within the crate. The bead JMAP-x2gd.79 explicitly called these out as 'lower-leverage and could be folded in or skipped depending on workspace policy'.

4. **String-arg constructors** (e.g. site-counter helpers, error builders) — many will fail to convert because String fields have non-const Drop. Triage per-site.

Plan when this is worked:
- Start with jmap-types foundation; it propagates downstream automatically.
- For each crate, run clippy --fix to apply automatically; review the resulting diff.
- For sites that fail to compile after const conversion (Drop-non-const fields), revert and add a brief comment explaining why.
- Consider a workspace-wide `#[allow(clippy::missing_const_for_fn)]` on internal helpers if the maintenance burden of per-site judgment exceeds the value.

Engineering basis: cosmetic + library-kit-API-surface. Zero runtime cost. Real benefit for downstream consumers that want const construction (e.g., DEFAULT_LIMITS in a stoa/kith config module).
title: Workspace sweep: clippy::nursery::missing_const_for_fn across all crates (~100+ sites)
